subject: Clearstream enablement: console + API sandbox setup
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Morris <elaine@clearstreamhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Clearstream enablement: console + API sandbox setup

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the quick call last week. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a combined console walkthrough and API/sandbox enablement session so your engineers and product team can get hands-on with the Redwood Console, API keys, and the sandbox environment.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 22 Sep, 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET (recommended)
- Wed 23 Sep, 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET
- Thu 24 Sep, 1:00pm PT / 4:00pm ET

Draft agenda (attached): 60–90 min
- 0–10 min: intros & objectives
- 10–35 min: Console walkthrough (routes, throttles, monitoring)
- 35–65 min: API keys, sandbox access, example calls
- 65–90 min: Q&A and next steps

Pre-reqs we need from your side:
- A list of IPs to allowlist for sandbox access (attach as CSV)
- One technical attendee who can run cURL or Postman (or we can pair-program)
- Optional: SSO domain details if you prefer SAML test users

I attached the enablement agenda and a short sandbox access checklist — please review and tell us which slot works best and who will join. Dev (cc'd) will handle sandbox provisioning.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: enablement_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
Attachment: sandbox_access_instructions.md (MD, 9KB)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. The 22 Sep slot at 2:00pm ET works best for our team. Attendees will be:
- Elaine Morris (PM)
- Mike Torres (Lead Engineer)
- Priya Singh (Security lead) — may drop after the IP allowlist discussion

Two quick asks: could we make this 90 minutes? We have a few specific integration questions. Also, I can send the IPs later today — Mike will be the point of contact for any network configs.

Best,
Elaine
Director, Product
Clearstream Health

P.S. Can you also share a short pre-call for stakeholders a day before (30 min) to align objectives?
